name: roodriigoooo-trail
description: Trail is a pi extension for navigating/preserving the useful artifacts of an agent session. Browse lanes such as commands, errors, files, code blocks, prompts, and model responses; copy or inject any artifact into the prompt; and create structured checkpoints that allow work to continue in a fresh session without dragging along the full context.
